name: Yas Marina Circuit

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways 168477013, 1469184731, 1469184732, 188337196, 1255169703, 1255169704 (2021 layout), (c) OSM contributors; start line from Esri World Imagery (grid/gantry on the pit straight)
sources.width: published: FIA grade 1 circuit, ~15 m typical, start straight ~16 m, marina/hotel section ~12-13 m (mapped by section, not measured)
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (https://copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com/), rolling 25th-percentile (+-45 m) to suppress grandstand/bridge/hotel spikes, then robust-median smoothed; circuit is essentially flat
sources.camber: none (30 m DEM cannot resolve crossfall)
sources.pit: OSM ways 176695254/176695255/176695253 (pit lane along the start straight, exit via tunnel to the left side of Turn 2)
sources.trim: medium downforce: two long straights but slow hotel/marina section; teams run close to Spa-level wings
sources.pitLimit: FIA F1 Sporting Regulations / event notes: 80 km/h
sources.pitLoss: public pre-race analyses (~20-22 s total stop loss)

notes: 2021 reprofile (T5 hairpin, T9 sweeper, hotel section). No sprint in 2026. Turn numbers 1-16 assigned from curvature peaks; pit entry position approximate.
